about_the_game:
Discount Disclaimer:

    Matters Matter 0 won't be on sale and the price will keep rising. The earlier, the cheaper.

* Semiconductor Revolution = Game Revolution

    The architecture of GPU does NOT fit the computing of virtual matters. We have to design a brand-new chip: PhPU -- not only with much better performance, but also much cheaper than GPU. PhPU will certainly reinvent the game!

    The earlier you get Matters Matter 0, the sooner we will change the world!

Optical Rendering

    Reflection and refraction make the gaming world prettier!  

Matter = Freedom

    Nothing else. Thus you are totally free to build whatever.

Chemicals & Reactions

    The whole periodic table of elements and their compounds are available (as exhaustive as possible), with all kinds of reactions and all kinds of effects:

    Combustion, solution, precipitation...

Thermodynamics

    Matters can change state according to temperature: ice, water, vapor...

    Heat can transfer: different matters have different properties.
